# Design point P003

## Description

The system distributes repository replicas across racks to withstand rack- and node-level failures, while servers use quiesced rolling reboots to maintain service during sequential maintenance within bounded failure domains. Clients use compressed Git indexes to reduce local repository metadata size, complementing the server-side durability and operational scaling.
